## Problem Statement

`slugify` (`src/slugify.mjs`) returns slugs of any length, and some of our URLs come out over 100 characters.

## Solution

`slugify` takes an optional `maxLength`, and the slug never exceeds it.

## User Stories

1. As a Developer, I pass `{ maxLength }` as a second argument to `slugify`, so that the slug is never longer than it
2. As a Developer, I get the slug cut at the last word boundary that fits, so that no word is cut in half
3. As a Developer, I get a slug that never ends in a hyphen after a cut, so that URLs stay clean
4. As a Developer, I get the first word cut at `maxLength` when that word alone is longer, so that the slug is never empty
5. As a Developer, I get the whole slug when `maxLength` is absent or the slug already fits, so that existing callers see no change

## Testing Decisions

Unit tests with `node:test`, beside the existing ones in `test/slugify.test.mjs`.
